instructions: Extract the "Recipients of a Federal Pell Grant" column printed six-year graduation rate from the first/most recent visible B4-B11 cohort grid as the printed 0-1 ratio (for example 0.94), never as a percent and never recomputed from the count rows above. Preserve the exact printed decimal in `raw_value`. This is CDS item B11, bound to the sixth-year completion interval end date printed on the B4-B11 cohort grid. Students who also received a subsidized Stafford Loan remain in the "Recipients of a Federal Pell Grant" column.
description: Printed six-year graduation rate, as a 0-1 ratio, for students who received a Federal Pell Grant in the primary adjusted cohort.

instructions: Extract the "Total (sum of 3 columns to the left)" column adjusted-cohort row from the first/most recent visible B4-B11 cohort grid independently as printed. Use arithmetic against the printed initial-cohort and allowable-exclusions rows only for validation; never overwrite a printed disagreement. This is CDS item B6.
description: Adjusted primary cohort count of all first-time, full-time bachelor's-degree-seeking students, regardless of aid group, after allowable exclusions are removed from the initial cohort.

instructions: Extract the "Total (sum of 3 columns to the left)" column "completed within four years" row from the first/most recent visible B4-B11 cohort grid, bound to the four-year completion cutoff date printed on the B4-B11 cohort grid. This is CDS item B7.
description: Count of all first-time, full-time bachelor's-degree-seeking students in the adjusted primary cohort who completed a bachelor's or equivalent program within four years, regardless of aid group.

instructions: Extract the "Total (sum of 3 columns to the left)" column "completed after four, within five years" row from the first/most recent visible B4-B11 cohort grid, bound to the fifth-year completion interval start and end dates printed on the B4-B11 cohort grid. This is incremental, not cumulative with the four-year count. This is CDS item B8.
description: Incremental count of all first-time, full-time bachelor's-degree-seeking students in the adjusted primary cohort who completed a bachelor's or equivalent program after four years but within five years, regardless of aid group.

instructions: Extract the "Total (sum of 3 columns to the left)" column "completed after five, within six years" row from the first/most recent visible B4-B11 cohort grid, bound to the sixth-year completion interval start and end dates printed on the B4-B11 cohort grid. This is incremental, not cumulative with the four- or five-year counts. This is CDS item B9.
description: Incremental count of all first-time, full-time bachelor's-degree-seeking students in the adjusted primary cohort who completed a bachelor's or equivalent program after five years but within six years, regardless of aid group.

instructions: Extract the "Total (sum of 3 columns to the left)" column cumulative "total completed within six years" row from the first/most recent visible B4-B11 cohort grid. This is the cumulative six-year count, distinct from the incremental fifth- and sixth-year rows above. This is CDS item B10, bound to the sixth-year completion interval end date printed on the B4-B11 cohort grid.
description: Cumulative count of all first-time, full-time bachelor's-degree-seeking students in the adjusted primary cohort who completed a bachelor's or equivalent program within six years, regardless of aid group.

instructions: Extract the "Total (sum of 3 columns to the left)" column printed six-year graduation rate from the first/most recent visible B4-B11 cohort grid as the printed 0-1 ratio (for example 0.94), never as a percent and never recomputed from the count rows above. Preserve the exact printed decimal in `raw_value`. This is CDS item B11, bound to the sixth-year completion interval end date printed on the B4-B11 cohort grid.
description: Printed six-year graduation rate, as a 0-1 ratio, for all first-time, full-time bachelor's-degree-seeking students in the adjusted primary cohort, regardless of aid group.

instructions: Extract the B22 entering-cohort count row independently as printed. This count is new in the 2025-26 CDS edition; treat its absence in earlier editions (for example Yale 2024-25, which reports only the percent) as template-version absence, not zero. The reported entering count is not necessarily the same as an adjusted-cohort denominator used elsewhere. The B22 population is all full-time, first-time, bachelor's (or equivalent) degree-seeking undergraduate students who entered in the B22 entering term printed on the form or the preceding summer term.
description: Number of full-time, first-time, bachelor's (or equivalent) degree-seeking undergraduate students entering in the B22 entering term printed on the form, including entrants from the preceding summer term.

instructions: Extract the B22 still-enrolled-next-fall count row independently as printed. This count is new in the 2025-26 CDS edition; treat its absence in earlier editions as template-version absence, not zero. The B22 population is all full-time, first-time, bachelor's (or equivalent) degree-seeking undergraduate students who entered in the B22 entering term printed on the form or the preceding summer term.
description: Number of full-time, first-time, bachelor's (or equivalent) degree-seeking undergraduate students who entered in the B22 entering term printed on the form or the preceding summer term and were still enrolled in the B22 follow-up term printed on the form.

instructions: Copy the B22 printed retention percent exactly as a string (for example "96%"), preserving any qualifier such as "<1%". The official printed rate can include early completers and specific exclusions defined by the form; never recompute it from the entering and still-enrolled counts. The B22 population is all full-time, first-time, bachelor's (or equivalent) degree-seeking undergraduate students who entered in the B22 entering term printed on the form or the preceding summer term.
description: Printed first-year retention rate for full-time, first-time, bachelor's (or equivalent) degree-seeking undergraduate students who entered in the B22 entering term printed on the form or the preceding summer term.
